knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The guideline asks for used linen to be bagged where it is used. The other options contradict that rule.
A household machine serves only a patient's private clothing, run with a fitting detergent in hot water. Everything else is facility linen.
Storage must be clean, dry and protected, kept apart from used linen. The remaining options fail one of those tests.

practicalCriteria: Learner bags a simulated soiled item where it is used, sealing a leak-proof bag and cleaning their hands afterwards.
Learner identifies the storage fault in a photograph or simulated store where clean and used linen are mixed.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Linen handling record for the simulated shift
stopWorkCriteria: Linen is soiled with body substance and the learner has no protective equipment
Someone is rinsing or sorting linen inside a patient room
Clean and used linen are found stored together
